about: Every lamp pattern of app/src/status_led.c and whether the spending profile (app/spending.conf with a pinned enrollment authority) can show it. steps are on/off times in milliseconds; situations is the exact list for the spending profile, in order of appearance, and an empty list is a dark lamp. callers are 'file function'. test/test_led_patterns.py compares the list with the sources, and 'test_led_patterns.py --phone' with the app's board guide. phoneText is what a step's LED text must contain to describe the pattern; signal is what the meaning and the pattern of its row in the app's LED list must contain.

P_MODE.meaning: connection window after SW4 long, or recovery window after SW3 long; 120 s

P_PRESSED.meaning: SW1 was taken; the PIN starts after it

P_PIN_START.meaning: enter the PIN (again to confirm it when it is set)

P_PIN_KEEP.meaning: SW3 kept the digit, or SW2 cleared the entry; the fourth SW3 ends the entry without it

P_LOCKED.meaning: the PIN must wait after five or more wrong ones

P_RESET_ARMED.meaning: button reset after the PIN: SW1 long within 10 s erases, anything else cancels

P_RESET_DONE.meaning: erased; the board restarts after 4 s

P_FAILED.meaning: SW2, a wrong PIN, or any refusal after the button; also a refused or cancelled button reset and an unfinished erase

P_PAIRING.why: main.c opens the recovery window instead while device_pilot_active()

P_BONDED.why: pairing is accepted in pairing mode only

P_LOCATE.why: op 0x70 to 0x72 need a personal vault or an HD root, and the spending profile has neither

P_SIGNED.meaning: the order or the return was signed; 30 s at most, and a new request ends it

P_APPROVED.meaning: the kiosk reported an approved payment
P_APPROVED.why: only the legacy payment session reports an outcome

situations.situation: idle, also while a phone is connected

SW3 long: recovery window, 120 s

SW1 taken, then the PIN

situations.situation: registration: PIN set
situations.note: the second P_PIN_START asks for the same PIN again; success ends dark

situations.situation: order approved and signed
situations.note: also when the answer did not reach the phone: the stored signature can be read back

situations.situation: return signed
return address saved, registration done
situations.note: dark after the last PIN light

situations.situation: SW2
wrong PIN, the two new PINs differ, or the 45 s ran out
refused after SW1: expired, over the daily limit, phone gone, signing or saving failed
situations.note: the PIN patterns come in between when the PIN was asked for

situations.situation: PIN asked for during its wait
request refused before the buttons, or it ran out without a press
situations.note: P_WAITING just stops; only the phone knows the reason

situations.situation: app or operator reset approved
situations.note: the app's asks for the PIN in between; the operator's does not, and P_PRESSED may be cut short

situations.situation: SW2 and SW3 for 5 s, PIN right
button reset confirmed
button reset refused, cancelled or timed out
button reset during the PIN wait
